row.requirement_text: A maximum of 10 Free Users shall be allowed in Webble with limited access to features.
row.user_story: As a product owner, I want a maximum of 10 Free Users in Webble with limited access to features, so that free use is capped.
row.technical_task: Limit Webble to a maximum of 10 Free Users and restrict their access to features.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 Free Users exist, when an 11th Free User tries to register, then the registration is refused.
Given a Free User, when the user opens a feature outside the limited access, then the feature is not available.
row.rationale: Role assumed: product owner. The 11th user in the first criterion follows from the maximum of 10.

row.requirement_text: Create a message digest in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210©.
row.user_story: As a compliance officer, I want a message digest created according to the standard in 170.210, so that data integrity can be checked.
row.technical_task: Create a message digest in accordance with the standard specified in 170.210.
acceptance_criteria: Given data to be protected, when a message digest is created, then it follows the standard specified in 170.210.
Given a message digest, when it is reviewed, then it conforms to the standard in 170.210.
row.rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The standard itself is only referenced; the section symbol in the source text is garbled.

row.requirement_text: The Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation) to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
row.requirement_text_raw: The  Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation)  to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
row.user_story: As a clinician, I want the Clinical Decision Support capability to conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation), so that authorship and responsibility for data are shown.
row.technical_task: Make the Clinical Decision Support capability conform to function IN.1.8 (Information Attestation) to show authorship and responsibility for the data.
acceptance_criteria: Given data in the Clinical Decision Support capability, when it is displayed, then its authorship is shown.
Given data in the Clinical Decision Support capability, when it is displayed, then the person responsible for the data is shown.
row.rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The content of IN.1.8 is not given.

row.requirement_text: The system shall support real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring/control, and PLD/FPGA personality updates over the network.
row.user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the system to support real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring and control, and PLD/FPGA personality updates over the network, so that I can run and maintain the instrument remotely.
row.technical_task: Support real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring/control and PLD/FPGA personality updates over the network.
acceptance_criteria: Given the network connection, when an engineer runs a correlator operation, then it runs in real time.
Given the network connection, when an engineer sends a PLD/FPGA personality update, then the update is applied.
row.rationale: Role assumed: observatory engineer. "Real-time" is not quantified.

row.requirement_text: Only adjusters can request recycled parts audit reports. No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.
row.requirement_text_raw: Only adjusters can request recycled parts audit reports. No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.'
row.user_story: As a claims manager, I want only adjusters to request recycled parts audit reports, so that these audits are controlled.
row.technical_task: Allow only users with the adjuster role to request recycled parts audits and audit reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the adjuster role, when the user requests a recycled parts audit report, then the request is accepted.
Given a user without the adjuster role, when the user requests a recycled parts audit, then the request is refused.

row.requirement_text: Click 'Add' to schedule an office visit.
row.user_story: As a receptionist, I want to click Add to schedule an office visit, so that I can book visits.
row.technical_task: Provide an Add button that starts scheduling of an office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the schedule, when the user clicks Add, then the office visit scheduling is started.
Given the scheduling, when the user completes it, then the office visit is scheduled.

row.requirement_text: On cards that are aware of logical channels, the MANAGE CHANNEL commands are only processed by the OPEN and are not dispatched to an Application.
row.user_story: As a card issuer, I want MANAGE CHANNEL commands processed only by the OPEN and not passed on to an Application, so that channel management stays in the OPEN.
row.technical_task: Process MANAGE CHANNEL commands in the OPEN on cards that are aware of logical channels and do not dispatch them to any Application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a card that is aware of logical channels, when a MANAGE CHANNEL command arrives, then the OPEN processes it.
Given a MANAGE CHANNEL command, when it is handled, then it is not dispatched to an Application.

row.requirement_text: System shall restrict users from viewing other users' details to ensure privacy and security.
row.user_story: As a user, I want other users unable to view my details, so that my privacy and security are protected.
row.technical_task: Prevent users from viewing the details of other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, when one tries to view the other's details, then access is denied.
Given a user, when the user opens their own details, then they are shown.

row.requirement_text: Sensitive data will be encrypted before being sent over insecure connections like the internet.
row.user_story: As a user, I want sensitive data encrypted before it is sent over insecure connections like the internet, so that it cannot be read in transit.
row.technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data before it leaves over an insecure connection such as the internet.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data to be sent over the internet, when it is sent, then it is encrypted first.
Given an intercepted transmission, when it is read, then the sensitive data cannot be understood.

row.requirement_text: Enter the appropriate information and click 'Save Form' to return to the Encounter summary page.
row.user_story: As a clinician, I want to enter the appropriate information and click Save Form to return to the Encounter summary page, so that my entry is saved.
row.technical_task: Add a Save Form button that saves the form and returns to the Encounter summary page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed form, when the user clicks Save Form, then the information is saved.
Given the information is saved, when the save completes, then the Encounter summary page is displayed.

row.requirement_text: After the journey, users shall receive a feedback form to provide feedback based on their journey experience.
row.user_story: As a traveler, I want a feedback form after my journey, so that I can describe my experience.
row.technical_task: Send a feedback form to users after each journey.
acceptance_criteria: Given a journey has ended, when it is finished, then the user receives a feedback form.
Given a feedback form, when the user submits it, then the feedback about the journey experience is saved.

row.requirement_text: Record disclosures made for treatment payment and health care operations.
row.requirement_text_raw: Record disclosures made for treatment  payment  and health care operations.
row.user_story: As a privacy officer, I want disclosures made for treatment, payment and health care operations recorded, so that disclosures can be reviewed.
row.technical_task: Record each disclosure made for treatment, payment or health care operations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a disclosure for treatment, payment or health care operations, when it is made, then it is recorded.
Given recorded disclosures, when the privacy officer opens them, then the disclosures are shown.

row.requirement_text: The iTrust user (admin) has been authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC3).
row.user_story: As an administrator, I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can work in it (UC3).
row.technical_task: Require the iTrust admin to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin with valid credentials, when the admin logs in, then the admin is authenticated.
Given an admin without valid credentials, when the admin logs in, then authentication fails.
row.rationale: Role stated: admin. The sentence states a precondition of use case UC3.

row.requirement_text: Each syndrome shall represent an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
row.requirement_text_raw: Each syndrome shall (3.2.2.6.4) represent an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
row.user_story: As a systems engineer, I want each syndrome to mean an occurrence of the indicated error between the previous and current packet deliveries, so that errors are placed in time.
row.technical_task: Define each syndrome as an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs between the delivery of two packets, when the syndrome is read, then it indicates that occurrence.
Given no error occurs between the two deliveries, when the syndrome is read, then it does not indicate the error.

row.requirement_text: Store contact details of a received SMS or e-mail to the address book application.
row.requirement_text_raw: 3. Store contact details of a received SMS or e-mail to the address book application.
row.user_story: As a user, I want contact details from a received SMS or e-mail saved to the address book, so that I can reach the sender later.
row.technical_task: Store the contact details of a received SMS or e-mail in the address book application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a received SMS, when the user chooses to store the contact, then the details are saved in the address book application.
Given a received e-mail, when the user chooses to store the contact, then the details are saved in the address book application.

row.requirement_text: All three edge points shall be equal to the reference point if the extension of the object is smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction.
row.user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want all three edge points set equal to the reference point when the object is smaller than the required accuracy, so that tiny objects are not over-described.
row.technical_task: Set all three edge points equal to the reference point when the extension of the object is smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object whose extension is smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction, when its edge points are determined, then all three equal the reference point.
Given an object whose extension is not smaller than the required accuracy, when its edge points are determined, then they are not forced to equal the reference point.
row.rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. The leading "All" is read as all three edge points.
